_comment: Pipeline settings. 'seasons' is used when --seasons is not passed. Accepts a range '2022-2026', a list '2022,2024', or 'last5'.
_current_comment: null = use the current calendar year. Seasons before the current one are treated as complete and are not re-fetched unless --force.
_expected_comment: Number of real WNBA teams per season (All-Star teams excluded). Used by validation. Add a row when a new season or expansion happens.
